sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A right triangle has legs 5 and 12 and hypotenuse 13. Angle θ is opposite the leg of length 5. Find cos θ as an exact fraction in lowest terms.
A right triangle has legs 8 and 15. Find the hypotenuse.
Express sin 40° as a cosine of another angle, and explain why the two are equal.
choices: cos 40°, because sine and cosine are always equal
cos 130°, because the angles differ by a right angle
cos 140°, because the angles are supplementary
cos 50°, because the two angles are complementary and swap the roles of opposite and adjacent

items.prompt: From a point 4 m from the base of a tower, the angle of elevation to the top is θ, and the tower is 3 m tall. Which equation correctly determines θ?
choices: sin θ = 3/4
tan θ = 4/3
tan θ = 3/4
cos θ = 3/4

items.prompt: A right triangle has legs 20 and 21 and hypotenuse 29. Angle θ is opposite the leg of length 20. Find sin θ as an exact fraction in lowest terms.
A right triangle has legs 15 and 36. Find the hypotenuse.
Express sin 60° as a cosine of another angle, and explain why the two are equal.
choices: cos 30°, because the two angles are complementary and swap the roles of opposite and adjacent
cos 120°, because the angles are supplementary
cos 150°, because the angles differ by a right angle
cos 60°, because sine and cosine are always equal

items.prompt: From a point 160 m from the base of a tower, the angle of elevation to the top is θ, and the tower is 36 m tall. Which equation correctly determines θ?
A right triangle has legs 18 and 80 and hypotenuse 82. Angle θ is opposite the leg of length 18. Find cos θ as an exact fraction in lowest terms.
